annotations.title: Crypto research, coin brief: price, funding, depth, signals

description: One call to research a single coin traded on Hyperliquid (BTC, ETH, SOL, HYPE and about 200 more): price, 24-hour change, volume and open interest, the funding rate now and over the last 3 days, order-book depth and spread, technical readings on the 4-hour and daily charts (RSI, MACD, moving averages, Bollinger, volatility), and market-wide sentiment (Fear & Greed, attributed). Use before a trade or for a coin brief. Example: coin=ETH. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
